name: Gmail
tagline: World's largest email service, becoming a Gemini-powered AI inbox
facts: Not split; in Workspace and Google Cloud ($24.8B Q2'26)

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Google: organise the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Email as a proactive assistant that summarises, prioritises and acts, not a list to triage.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Free Gmail as identity and data hub; upsell storage and AI (Google One AI Pro/Ultra) and Workspace seats.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Google Account identity, best-in-class spam filtering, 15GB free storage, deep Calendar, Drive, Meet integration.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Gemini 3 in Gmail: AI Overviews, AI Inbox, Help Me Write; Gemini bundled into every Workspace plan.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Will AI Inbox make users open Gmail less, and if so how does Google measure success?

customers.who: Free users needing personal email and login
customers.pain: Overflowing inbox, promotions, missed bills and bookings
customers.why: Free, reliable, great spam filter, identity for Android and Google services

customers.pain: No time to read long threads or search old emails
customers.why: Inbox-wide Q&A, Proofread, AI Inbox, 2TB storage bundled

customers.who: Startups and small firms on Workspace
customers.pain: Need professional email on own domain without IT team
customers.why: $7/user Starter with Gemini included, easy admin, Docs and Meet bundled

customers.pain: Need secure, compliant email with AI at scale
customers.why: Data not used to train models, admin controls, cheaper than Microsoft 365 Copilot

customers.who: Brands sending newsletters, buying Promotions ads
customers.why: Promotions tab ads, sender guidelines reward good senders

rows.how: Starter $7, Standard $14, Plus $22 per user/month, Gemini included

rows.who_uses: Consumers needing storage or advanced AI
rows.how: Monthly storage tiers; AI Pro and Ultra unlock Gmail AI features
Auction-priced native ads in Promotions and Social tabs
Gmail anchors identity and retention across Google services

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: No Gmail figure; mostly Workspace seats and Google One subs, plus Gmail ads inside Google advertising.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: ~1.8B users mostly free; 11M paying Workspace customers and Google One subscribers fund the product.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Storage and AI inference costs rise per user; Gemini bundling lifted Workspace prices 17–22% in 2025.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: AI Pro upsell, Workspace price-to-value, AI Inbox global rollout, India and emerging-market SMBs.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Bundle AI into the paid tier rather than sell an add-on: higher price, higher perceived value, less churn.

friction: Best AI features locked behind paid plans
AI Inbox only in US/English, limited rollout
Promotions clutter and newsletters overwhelm inbox
Privacy worries about Gemini reading emails

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: AI agents bypass the inbox; Microsoft enterprise lock-in; privacy regulation
